items.title: Automatic Guardian HTTP 451 double-slash retry
items.description: Retry region-blocked Guardian API calls via the Arman-compatible double-leading-slash path. This is conditional and does not rewrite unrelated URLs.

items.title: Subscriptions disabled by default
items.description: Optional temporary proxy recovery can be enabled in Subscriptions. Two preconfigured GitHub Raw URLs remain editable, with unlimited added sources and ordering controls.

items.title: Android reliability fixes retained
items.description: Improved data allowance refresh, uTLS-backed VLESS Reality/gRPC recovery when explicitly enabled, and a compact selected location inside the Connect card.

items.title: Consistent multi-platform updates
items.description: New installable version 2.0.4 across all supported processor architectures.
